message: Build a local slot booking app. Python standard library only; no runtime network assets or build step. Serve on 127.0.0.1 using python server.py --port PORT --db PATH (SQLite). GET /api/slots returns an array of {"id":integer,"start":ISO datetime,"end":ISO datetime,"booked_by":string or null}. POST /api/slots with {"start":"2030-01-02T10:00","end":"2030-01-02T11:00"} returns 201 slot. Require valid ISO datetimes and start < end. Reject overlapping slots with 409 (adjacent endpoints allowed). POST /api/slots/ID/book {"name":"..."} returns 200 booked slot; name must be nonempty, <=80 characters. A booked slot returns 409 on another booking; simultaneous bookings allow exactly one success and one 409. Persist slots/bookings across restart. Invalid or malformed JSON returns 400 with a nonempty JSON error string; unknown resource returns 404. README.md explains startup. At / serve index.html: responsive accessible UI, render slots as [data-slot-id=ID], each with input name=name and button[data-action=book] that books through API; show booked name, inline validation, visible conflict and API failure states, empty state, keyboard focus, no horizontal overflow at 375px. Include import_slots.py FILE.csv --db PATH: header start,end; skip invalid/overlapping rows, import valid rows into same SQLite database and print "imported N, skipped M" (exit 0); unreadable file exits 2.

profile.platform: Windows, Python 3 standard library; desktop and mobile browser
profile.defaults: Smallest solution described; no accounts, network assets, deployment or paid services.
